_comment: Data mau cho tinh nang 'Hoat dong theo mang dich vu'. Moi phan tu trong 'events' la BODY gui toi POST http://localhost:9001/api/v1/admin/customer-events/send
DIEU_KIEN_BAT_BUOC: 1) Event chi match vao profile khi da ton tai ProfileSourceRecord cung (sourceSystem, sourceCustomerId) tro toi mot MasterProfile. Neu khong -> syncStatus=UNMATCHED, masterProfileId=null -> KHONG hien trong API service-lines.

2) Cap (CAS, CAS-D003) duoi day la cap DA match vao profile id=69 (chinh la cap sinh ra ket qua BCCP/EMS cua ban). Neu profile 69 cua ban duoc tao tu cap khac, hay THAY sourceSystem/sourceCustomerId o TAT CA event ben duoi bang dung cap do.
3) Chi eventType=createOrder + co serviceCode map duoc trong ServiceCodeMapper + occurredAt trong 12 thang gan nhat (>= 2025-07-22) moi duoc tinh vao service-lines.
4) messageId/event_code tu sinh UUID trong producer -> khong can dat, khong lo trung.
5) Can Kafka dang chay. Unomi co the tat (sync loi van khong anh huong luu event + match profile).
MANG_SE_BAT_SANG_DANG_DUNG: Logistics (KHO_VAN), PPBL (POS_RETAIL), MVNO (SIM_DATA_MVNO), TCBC (THU_HO_COD, co COD). Cong voi BCCP (EMS) da co san -> 5/7 mang Dang dung.
